title: Hunts FH-022: Build merchant redemption station

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 2, Rewards. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Issue one-use grant token, show only issuer data, handle retry, void and expiry. Done when: Two staff terminals redeem once and a revoked grant cannot be reused. Requires: FH-020, FH-021. Owner role: Web.
